Hi there kennel team,
Airflow checks came up mid-afternoon, so just a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. The ground crew has been moving carriers carefully between services, and that steady handling is helping keep things calm for the pets and the travelers. Please keep the desk ledger updated whenever there is a service change, even if it seems minor.

For the Merrowgate relief stop, <<FACT F017>>. I want that detail kept clean in the internal thread and not repeated anywhere else, since it is already covered here. If Mateo Morgan, Elena Andersson, or Phoebe are on your list today, give their cases an extra glance and make sure labels, transfer notes, and handoff remarks all line up before anything leaves the desk.

Also, if you spot a carrier that needs a fresh look, move it with care and tell the next team member right away. A quick update now saves a messy fix later, and it keeps the passenger experience smooth without making a fuss. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping the handoffs tidy.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
